About.Tagline: A multi-protocol server workbench for Windows: SSH terminal, SFTP / FTP transfers, RDP desktop and live Linux monitoring.
About.Features:
• Unlimited concurrent SSH sessions
• Passwords and passphrases protected by Windows DPAPI
• Terminal powered by xterm.js (WebView2)
• RDP uses the built-in Windows mstsc client
• Metrics collected from /proc and df

Rdp.Notes1: MobaDesk launches the built-in Windows Remote Desktop client (mstsc) with a generated .rdp profile. NLA, clipboard and local drive redirection are supported. The password is written as a DPAPI blob that only the current Windows user can decrypt.
Rdp.Notes2: If the target server does not allow saved credentials, mstsc will prompt again. The session runs in its own window; close it to disconnect.
